title: A complete Noetherian local domain has a nonempty regular open
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where local means that $\mathfrak m$ is its unique maximal ideal. Assume that $R$ is a domain (a nonzero ring without zero divisors) and is $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then there exists a nonempty Zariski-open subset $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] such that $R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] for every $\mathfrak p\in U$.
